name: claude-codex-consult
description: A Claude Code plugin that turns OpenAI Codex into a standing reasoning partner with thread continuity and a file-based record of every consultation.

plugins.name: codex-consult
plugins.description: Consult OpenAI Codex from Claude Code over your ChatGPT subscription: one command per consultation, fork/resume thread continuity, read-only sandbox, a brief/reply file pair plus a JSON ledger you can commit, structured findings tracked by id, a reviewer roster with a sequential review panel, and a second reviewer through the same bridge.
